svg.title: It is positive definite on skew-Hermitian matrices and invariant under conjugation by G. Fix an orthonormal real color basis for this inner product, identifying the algebra with Rdim g. A color vector has matrix Frobenius norm √m times its color norm. The group chord is chord(g) = ∥g −1∥F/√m. Inversion and conjugation preserve it, and chord(gh) ≤chord(g) + chord(h). The Lie-algebra curvature of a holonomy g is the color projection of (g −g−1)/2. These normalizations are kept in the quadratic action, coupling slope and trace calculation.
